description: This file defines the Java interface 'ClientIdentifierReadPlatformService' which provides methods to retrieve client identifier data in the Fineract project.

classes.name: ClientIdentifierReadPlatformService
classes.description: Java interface providing methods to read client identifier data, including retrieval of all identifiers for a client and a specific identifier.

methods.name: retrieveClientIdentifiers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all client identifiers associated with the specified client ID.

methods.name: retrieveClientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a specific client identifier given the client ID and the client identifier ID.
